title: Hush Safe Irrigation Path
kicker: A narrow working path through mosslit water channels that rewards trust built in Hush.
hook: A narrow working path through mosslit water channels that rewards trust built in Hush.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The safe irrigation path is narrow, useful, and trusted: mosslit water, low bridges, and farm markers that only make sense if someone explained them.

blocks.label: Known For

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: There is no food out here, only the path and the work. A passing farmer might share a heel of bread and a warning about which plank gives. The water smells green and mineral, and the only sweetness is the moss-honey...
